provenance.note: Blinded single-subagent adjudication (MERGE-PLAN §2): vendor labels stripped, A/B randomized per file, candidate-pair focus. confirmed_delta promoted only after caller original-span confirmation.

base_member_text: load()+eval by filename stem (L179, L191) has the same fragility as the analytical script (variable name must match file stem).
audit_member_text: Filename/interface mismatch across L176-L194: load is followed by dot/underscore parsing and eval of the stripped filename as a variable, so paths with directories, multiple dots, or invalid identifier basenames can fail or bind the wrong loaded variable; no loaded-variable validation is done.

base_member_text: NRMSD denominator N=length(ina)+length(ina1) counts beach-filled NaN points as data (L244-245), unlike analyBM_01_SW.m which uses N=length(xn) -- small definitional difference between the two official scripts.
audit_member_text: Metric-domain inconsistency repeated from L232-L247 onward: interpolation NaNs are replaced by beach elevations and included in NRMSD, while maximum-amplitude error uses only the pre-fill finite set ina, so the two scores cover different model-support domains.

base_member_text: The t=60 echo row is labeled [30 ...] instead of [60 ...] (first line of the t=60 echo block, chunk boundary L401) -- copy-paste slip in the reported time index.
audit_member_text: Copy/paste output defect at L401: the t=60 H=0.0185 diagnostic prints leading label 30, unlike the calculation and plot that identify t=60 (L381-L415).

base_member_text: The final 'return' (L692) is redundant at function end; commented '%SELFE' alternatives (L662, L664) show model-specific tweaks left in the official script.
Panel axis windows [-2 20] for H=0.0185 vs the clip window [-10,20] used in the error computation (x_30n L232) -- errors include points outside the displayed axis.

audit_member_text: Use-before-supplied interface defect across L166 and L184: a one-argument call enters the else branch and evaluates isempty(filename2) even though filename2 was not supplied.

Wrong-interface guard across L517-L527: the H=0.30 t=15 model curve is conditioned on filename2, but its legend is conditioned on filename1. With only filename2 supplied the model curve lacks its label; with only filename1 supplied a nonexistent second-case model is labeled.

Every NRMSD divides by N and analytical range Norm, and every maximum error divides by the analytical maximum, without guards for empty overlap, zero range, or zero maximum (first occurrence L244-L247).
The model arrays are indexed through column 6 for a1 and column 5 for a2 without runtime shape checks; interpolation also assumes monotone, compatible coordinate columns.
